exams.name: Praxis Audiology (5343)
exams.blurb: National audiology examination used for state licensure and the ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence in audiology.

exams.name: Praxis Educational Leadership: Administration and Supervision (5412)
exams.blurb: Principal licensure test covering vision, instructional leadership, school culture, management, ethics and community engagement.

exams.name: Praxis Professional School Counselor (5422)
exams.blurb: Licensure test for school counselors covering counseling, consultation, programme delivery, data use and professional practice.

exams.name: Praxis Reading Specialist (5302)
exams.blurb: Test for reading specialists and literacy coaches, covering assessment, intervention, curriculum leadership and professional learning.

exams.name: Praxis School Librarian (5312)
exams.blurb: Licensure test for school librarians covering collection development, information literacy instruction, technology and programme administration.

exams.name: Praxis School Psychologist (5403)
exams.blurb: National school psychology test required for the NCSP credential and for certification in many states, aligned to NASP practice domains.

exams.name: Praxis Speech-Language Pathology (5331)
exams.blurb: National examination used for state licensure and the ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence in speech-language pathology.

exams.name: School Leaders Licensure Assessment (6990)
exams.blurb: Principal licensure assessment based on national leadership standards, combining selected-response items with constructed-response scenarios.

exams.name: School Superintendent Assessment (6991)
exams.blurb: District leadership assessment for aspiring superintendents, covering governance, finance, human capital and system-wide instructional leadership.

exams.name: Praxis Middle School English Language Arts (5047)
exams.blurb: Middle grades English test covering reading, literature, writing, language and the teaching of literacy to young adolescents.

exams.name: Praxis Middle School Mathematics (5164)
exams.blurb: Middle grades mathematics licensure test covering ratios, expressions, equations, geometry, statistics and probability.

exams.name: Praxis Middle School Science (5442)
exams.blurb: Middle grades science licensure test covering life, physical and earth science along with science practices and safety.

exams.name: Praxis Middle School Social Studies (5089)
exams.blurb: Middle grades social studies test covering United States and world history, government, geography, economics and social science methods.

exams.name: Praxis Principles of Learning and Teaching: Early Childhood (5621)
exams.blurb: Pedagogy test for early childhood candidates combining case studies with questions on development, instruction and assessment.

exams.name: Praxis Principles of Learning and Teaching: Grades 5-9 (5623)
exams.blurb: Middle grades pedagogy test covering adolescent development, instructional planning, assessment and professional responsibilities.

exams.name: Praxis Principles of Learning and Teaching: Grades 7-12 (5624)
exams.blurb: Secondary pedagogy test combining case histories with questions on learners, instruction, assessment and professional practice.

exams.name: Praxis Principles of Learning and Teaching: Grades K-6 (5622)
exams.blurb: Elementary pedagogy test covering child development, instructional strategies, assessment and communication with families.

exams.name: Praxis Principles of Learning and Teaching: PreK-12 (5625)
exams.blurb: All-grades pedagogy test for candidates whose licence spans preschool through grade twelve, such as art, music and world languages.

exams.name: Praxis Chinese (Mandarin): World Language (5665)
exams.blurb: Mandarin teacher licensure test assessing interpretive listening and reading plus presentational speaking and writing tasks.

exams.name: Praxis English to Speakers of Other Languages (5362)
exams.blurb: ESOL licensure test covering language acquisition, linguistics, instructional planning, assessment and cultural and professional issues.

exams.name: Praxis French: World Language (5174)
exams.blurb: French teacher licensure test assessing interpretive listening and reading plus recorded speaking and written presentational tasks.

exams.name: Praxis German: World Language (5183)
exams.blurb: German teacher licensure test assessing interpretive listening and reading plus presentational speaking and writing performance.

exams.name: Praxis Japanese: World Language (5661)
exams.blurb: Japanese teacher licensure test assessing interpretive listening and reading alongside presentational speaking and writing tasks.

exams.name: Praxis Latin (5601)
exams.blurb: Latin teacher licensure test covering reading comprehension of classical texts, grammar, Roman culture and language pedagogy.

exams.name: Praxis Russian: World Language (5671)
exams.blurb: Russian teacher licensure test assessing interpretive listening and reading plus presentational speaking and writing performance.

exams.name: Praxis Spanish: World Language (5195)
exams.blurb: The most widely taken Praxis world language test, assessing interpretive, presentational speaking and writing skills in Spanish.

exams.name: Praxis World Languages Pedagogy (5841)
exams.blurb: Language-neutral pedagogy test on communicative instruction, assessment, culture integration and technology in world language classrooms.

exams.name: Praxis Communication and Literacy Combined (5753)
exams.blurb: Combined literacy screening test made up of the reading and writing subtests, used by states requiring a communication skills measure.

exams.name: Praxis Communication and Literacy: Reading (5714)
exams.blurb: Reading comprehension subtest of the Praxis communication and literacy battery for prospective educators.

exams.name: Praxis Communication and Literacy: Writing (5724)
exams.blurb: Writing subtest of the Praxis communication and literacy battery, combining usage questions with two written essay tasks.

exams.name: Praxis Core Academic Skills for Educators: Combined (5752)
exams.blurb: Single sitting combining the reading, writing and mathematics Core subtests, the usual entry requirement for teacher preparation programmes.

exams.name: Praxis Core Academic Skills for Educators: Mathematics (5733)
exams.blurb: Basic mathematics skills test covering number, algebra, geometry, statistics and probability at the level expected of entering teachers.

exams.name: Praxis Core Academic Skills for Educators: Reading (5713)
exams.blurb: Reading skills test for prospective teachers, measuring key ideas, craft and structure, and integration of knowledge across passages.

exams.name: Praxis Core Academic Skills for Educators: Writing (5723)
exams.blurb: Writing skills test combining grammar and usage questions with argumentative and source-based essay tasks for entering teachers.

exams.name: Praxis Fundamental Subjects: Content Knowledge (5511)
exams.blurb: Broad content test across English, mathematics, science and social studies, often used to add or verify multi-subject teaching authority.
